bullets.text: The State government ordered civic agencies to complete flood mitigation work in Chennai and suburbs by October 15, and the office should monitor progress.
Chennai power shutdowns are scheduled across Velachery and other areas on September 30, and the office should monitor supply restoration for residents.
Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu expressed concern over poor road infrastructure at Ambattur industrial estate, and the office should review industrial access.
Residents in Manali are facing severe traffic congestion, and the office should coordinate with local authorities to ease commuter movement.
CtrlS and Ciena are building 100 Tb/s data centre networks connecting Chennai and other cities, and the office should track digital infrastructure expansion.
Billtrust opened a GCC in Hyderabad with a Rs 450 crore investment, and the office should watch regional investment trends in technology.
Cognizant reported that AI speeds up vulnerability discovery while enterprises struggle to fix risks, and the office should note cybersecurity challenges.
